_disclaimer: Fabricated demonstration data. This candidate, employer, and hiring process do not exist. Created to illustrate human-centered design patterns in recruiting workflows.

candidate.note: Name withheld in this view by design. The candidate's identity is not needed to evaluate the work, and hiding it here is itself a design choice.

sections.label: Skills
sections.issue: Listed inside prose rather than as a bulleted list. Two skills were not extracted.

sections.label: Certifications
sections.issue: Stored in a two-column table. The parser read the columns as one run-on line.

resume.narrative: Six years coordinating logistics for a regional distributor, then two years out of the workforce as a full-time caregiver, then eighteen months back in an operations role where they rebuilt the month-end reporting process. Community college associate degree, no four-year degree. Self-taught in SQL and Power BI.

missed.why: Never named directly. The candidate wrote 'wrote my own queries against the warehouse' in prose, which the parser scored as generic operations language.
Described as 'built the reporting the controller uses every month' with no tool named in that sentence.

skills.ambiguity_note: The strongest evidence of analytical skill in this application is a sentence about cutting month-end close from five days to one. It contains no skill keyword at all.

weights.note: Weights are locked until a person sets them. No model runs before this step.

proxy_alert.message: Stability is weighted above the review threshold. In this simulated pipeline, that factor is driven mostly by continuous-employment months, which screens out career gaps regardless of cause.
proxy_alert.basis: Simulated within this prototype. Not derived from a real workforce dataset.
proxy_alert.outcome: Recruiter reduced Stability from 35 to 15 before running the model.

assessment.one_line: Strong operational evidence, thin on named tooling. The gap is vocabulary, not capability.

evidence.claim: Has run analysis that a finance team depends on
evidence.support: Rebuilt month-end reporting; close time went from five days to one.
Wrote own queries rather than requesting extracts from IT.
Titles across eight years are coordination and operations.

provenance.prompt: Given the role requirements and the candidate's stated experience, score alignment 0 to 100. Weight demonstrated outcomes above named tools. Do not infer seniority from job titles.
provenance.inputs: Parsed experience section, candidate-corrected skills list, role requirement list
provenance.author: R. Okafor
provenance.note: The instruction not to infer seniority from titles was added after a review found the previous version penalized career changers.

provenance.prompt: Summarize the alignment judgment in one sentence a hiring manager can act on. No adjectives about the person. Describe the evidence, not the candidate.
provenance.author: T. Mensah
provenance.note: Authored by a different recruiter than the alignment prompt. Both are visible to the whole team.

events.text: Resume parsed. Three skills extracted, two sections flagged, certifications table failed to read.
Added SQL and Dashboard development, both missed by the parser. Corrections carried forward, marked as candidate-supplied.
Proxy warning raised on Stability at 35, above the review threshold of 30.
Reduced Stability to 15, raised Technical to 45 and Growth to 30. Reason given: gap is caregiving, not performance.
Expanded the evidence chain and opened provenance on the alignment score.
Screening rule matched: fewer than three years in an analytics-titled role. Automated rejection prepared.
Automated rejection blocked. Routed to human escalation queue. No message sent to the candidate.
Overrode the screening rule. Reason: the title heuristic measures job titles, not the work described. Advanced to first-round interview.
Decision sealed and written to the audit record. Chain complete.

escalations.reason: Fewer than three years in an analytics-titled role
escalations.note: The rule fired correctly. The rule itself was the problem.

adverse_impact.note: One group sits below the four-fifths threshold. In this prototype the drift began the week the Stability weighting was introduced across the pipeline, which is the point of tracking it.
